title: Nhà thờ bỏ hoang
about: Round x2 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian): an abandoned church. The far choir in front, lower and fuller than in Hầm mộ, a great bell tolling on every chord, the pad and drone under them; A minor at 44 bpm with the F and D minor of a slow hymn, the Phrygian B flat at the close. An original piece.
